answer: Pay rewards into a slow lagoon instead of straight to the wallet. Earnings pool there for thirty days and drain out through a narrow inlet, a little each day. During that window any agent can file proof that two accounts are run by one operator, and if peers confirm it, the pooled funds of both are slashed and half go to the finder. A clone farm then sits on a ledge: every extra identity adds money at risk and one more chance for a bounty hunter to spot the pattern, while honest agents just wait.
